summary.text: Sue Glick is a Republican who has represented Indiana Senate District 13, which covers LaGrange, Noble and Steuben counties and a portion of DeKalb County, since 2010.
She is the Assistant President Pro Tempore and chairs the Natural Resources Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to her Indiana Senate Republican biography, Glick graduated from Westview High School in Topeka, Indiana, and earned an A.B. in political science from Indiana University Bloomington and a J.D. from Indiana University, Indianapolis.
She is an attorney and served as LaGrange County Prosecuting Attorney from 1983 to 1990, and was president of the LaGrange County Election Board from 2008 to 2010.
She is the ranking member of the Agriculture and the Corrections and Criminal Law committees and also serves on the Judiciary and Rules and Legislative Procedure committees.
The page lists her as a past chair of the LaGrange County Republican Party and a recipient of the Indiana American Legion's Distinguished Public Service Award in 2013.
